python3 -c "
import humanize
import datetime as dt

print('=== R1: All required public names exposed ===')
required = ['Unit', 'abs_timedelta', 'date_and_delta', 'deactivate', 'gettext', 
            'gettext_noop', 'intword', 'naturaldate', 'naturaldelta', 'naturaltime',
            'ngettext', 'ngettext_noop', 'num_name', 'pgettext', 'precisedelta',
            'thousands_separator']
for name in required:
    assert hasattr(humanize, name), f'Missing: {name}'
print(f'✓ All {len(required)} required names present')

print()
print('=== R2: Year-level precision ===')
print(f'naturaldelta(370 days): {humanize.naturaldelta(dt.timedelta(days=370))}')
print(f'precisedelta(370 days): {humanize.precisedelta(dt.timedelta(days=370))}')

print()
print('=== R3: Large timedelta handling ===')
huge = dt.timedelta(days=999999999)
print(f'naturaldelta huge: {humanize.naturaldelta(huge)[:50]}...')
print(f'naturaltime huge: {humanize.naturaltime(huge)[:50]}...')

print()
print('=== R4: Type hints (verified via annotations) ===')
from humanize import naturaldelta, intcomma, Unit
print(f'naturaldelta has annotations: {bool(naturaldelta.__annotations__)}')
print(f'intcomma has annotations: {bool(intcomma.__annotations__)}')
print(f'Unit is enum: {isinstance(Unit, type)}')

print()
print('=== R5: metric function spacing ===')
from humanize import metric
print(f'metric(1, \"Hz\"): {repr(metric(1, \"Hz\"))}')
print(f'metric(-1500, \"V\"): {repr(metric(-1500, \"V\"))}')
print(f'metric(3, \"W\", 5): {repr(metric(3, \"W\", 5))}')
print(f'metric(1, \"°\"): {repr(metric(1, \"°\"))}')

print()
print('=== R6: intcomma ndigits=0 ===')
from humanize import intcomma
print(f'intcomma(1234.56789, ndigits=0): {repr(intcomma(1234.56789, ndigits=0))}')
print(f'intcomma(1234.5, ndigits=0): {repr(intcomma(1234.5, ndigits=0))}')

print()
print('All verifications passed!')
"
